reviews.text: Excellent Facility - Dobby thoroughly enjoys the staff and his playmates

Lily
We love Petopia for our 1year old Tea Cup Yorkie, Lily.  She has been at Petopia Daycare once a week for the last 3 months and loves her time there. She is fearless, and does not realize she is the smallest dog there. She enjoys running and playing with the Big Dogs. She has made so many doggie friends and thoroughly enjoys all the love and cuddles she get from the staff as well.  She gets excited as soon as we pull into the parking lot because she knows it is going to be a fun day. We also like that they have a Webcam so we can check in during the day to see what she is up to. We also appreciate that they have extra services you can get done while she is there, like nail cutting, bathing etc.  We highly recommend Petopia to anyone looking for Doggy Daycare for their special family member.
Amazing place!  I know the dogs are safe and happy and not in a crate all day.
Our dog loves to come here she’s always jumping out the door and running inside. We have boarded her and done daycare
We have been using Petopia for years, our dogs love it. It's a great place!
Good but are expensive

Petopia is a fantastic daycare for dogs! The staff are caring and enthusiastic, keeping pet parents informed about how their pets are doing. I appreciate the longer hours, especially when I have to work late. Most importantly, my dog bounds out of the car on arrival and cannot wait to play with his canine (and human!) pals for the day!
So glad my colleague made me aware of Petopia - it is now our go to place for doggie daycare!  Highly recommend.
Petopia hosted my dog Sabrina on multiple occasions for overnight boarding. Sabrina loves Petopia and we are at peace knowing our dog is having a great time there, while we are away.

We’ve boarded our dog, Mojo, at Petopia twice, and each stay was about 7–8 days while we were away on vacation.

The first time was especially hard for me because it was his very first time away from home. Everything was new to him, a new place, new people, and new dogs. As a dog mom, I was honestly so worried and spent much of our trip thinking about him.

What made all the difference was the amazing team at Petopia. Not only could I check on Mojo through the live cameras, but the staff also took the time to send me emails and photos to let me know how he was doing. Those thoughtful updates gave me so much peace of mind and allowed me to truly relax and enjoy our vacation.

Everyone at Petopia is so kind, caring, and genuinely loves the dogs. Mojo absolutely adores the staff, and it’s obvious that he feels safe and happy there.

Thank you for taking such wonderful care of our boy. I highly recommend Petopia to anyone looking for a reliable and caring place to board their dog. We’ll definitely be back!
Great fun for the furry guy, the staff takes great care in keeping the dogs safe and engaged. Definite peace of mind!
My dog Enzo does not want to leave when we come pick him up. Probably the best endorsement possible :)

I brought my 6 year old Golden Retriever to Petopia for boarding and an overnight stay last February.  She was always happy to enter the building, and her tail would wag enthusiastically while she received a very warm welcome from the staff. When it was time to take her home, she always seemed very relaxed and content.
It is good to know that the staff are all trained in pet first aid and positive reinforcement techniques to modify behaviour. The dogs are well supervised, the facility is spotlessly clean,  there is overnight supervision, and there is a large off leash back yard. These are all important considerations.

We absolutely love Petopia! Cooper has  attending daycare and boarding here, and we couldn't be happier with the care he receives. The staff are incredibly friendly and caring.
Cooper comes home happy, tired, and excited to return, which says everything about the experience he has there.

We are so grateful for the peace of mind Petopia provides and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy daycare and boarding facility for their furry family member.

Thank you, Petopia, for taking such great care of Cooper! :)

Petopia took wonderful care of our dog, who had to stay with them for two months. They treated her like their own loved pet. They were attentive to her needs for play, rest, and when she needed a break from group play. Petopia always responded quickly to my question and did their best to accommodate every request. Every time I took my dog to Petopia, I felt like she was joining a family.
They are amazing at Petopia! My dog loves going and also loves some of the staff at Petopia. They are very accommodating and helpful. Highly recommended!

The best boarding and day care service we have ever experienced!

The owner Pat is very knowledgeable, friendly, and patient with all of our questions and requests at all times. And everyone works there are super helpful and truly cares about our pets.

Our dog really loves going to Petopia! He is so excited for every time we pack his food for the visit, and he wags his tail and jumps with joy, knowing he’s going to Petopia.

You know that your dog will be in good hands when staying at Petopia! Highly recommend!

I've had a great experience with Petopia. My dog Cara genuinely loves going there, which says everything. She comes home happy, relaxed, and completely tired from a full day of activity and socializing.

The staff are clearly attentive and care about the dogs, and it shows in how comfortable and excited she is every time she goes. It gives me peace of mind knowing she’s in a safe, engaging environment while I’m at work.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a reliable and well-run daycare.

2026 UPDATE: We now take our 1 year old dog, Mabel, to this daycare - it is the only thing that truly tuckers her out! Still incredible, 6 years later!

2020 REVIEW:We take our young dog here and I can truly say that they are THE best doggy daycare in the city. We have done a lot of research and seen a lot of places, especially in the northern part of the city, and this is by far the best. They are incredibly affordable, the staff is amazing and your dog will come home POOPED! They even send home report cards home to update you on what friends your dog made and how they behaved. They were kind enough to send a gift bag from Santa Paws in her first week!!! Even when our girl was in heat, they were able to accomodate! We love Petopia and everyone that works there, thanks for everything!! I can't recommend them enough!

Jordan & Luna Lab
My dog is not very social, but when she goes, she’s always really happy and makes new doggy friends. We’ve used their doggy daycare and the rates are very reasonable, staff is friendly.
Really kind people running it. My dog has a great time. They even sent a report afterwards. Really appreciated that.

We travelled to get married, and we were really nervous to leave our little guy (Joey) for around a month, but we couldn’t have found a better place for him to stay! We were constantly updated about his experience, able to check in on him using live camera access whenever it was play time, and we could just tell how much he loved the staff by how excited he was to see them the next time we dropped him off! I would highly recommend Petopia, and Joey is a repeat visitor!

We started bringing our dog Lucy to Petopia for daycare a couple of months ago, and it has been fantastic. She always has a lot of fun, and I like that we're able to check in throughout the day via their cameras to see what kind of trouble she is getting herself into! The staff are friendly and take great care of the dogs, we also like getting her 'report cards' to hear about who she is making friends with. I'm including a few photos of her having fun at Petopia, along with a photo of Lucy in a post-Petopia-pass-out. Highly recommended!

Came upon this daycare because our dog ended up getting rejected from another one and we're so grateful that they gave Chief a chance because this allowed us to put him there for a few days when I went into labor and gave birth (gave them a heads up that this was our urgent focus & if it was possible to drop him last minute). It was very convenient because we typically bring him to camp in Uxbridge whenever we went away but this place is perfect for emergencies or anything local we have to attend that we can't bring dogs at. Ever since then, we would bring Chief there just for fun because they have several activities for them and photoshoots at least once a month and he seems to really enjoy it and the people there seem to love him. We're so grateful we have this place nearby who are willing to take care of our big dog, Chief! We know he's a handful so we really mean that!
Petopia is great for daycare and boarding.  Friendly staff that care about your dog.  My dog always comes home happy and played out!

Petopia has been a godsend for me and my 3 year old Golden Retriever, Louie. He has so much energy, that on the average day, I can never get him enough exercise. I love daycare days, as I don't feel any of that guilt, and I love how excited he gets as we approach the building. The staff are amazing with him - they get right down on the floor to greet him. He gives them a better reaction than I get at times - lol! He has made friends there and gets to play with his best friend who also goes there. The extra enrichment activities (LOVED the Santa photos!), and the grooming services I can add on at any time, are a real bonus. Thanks for taking such great care of my boy!
My dog loves Petopia, she can hardly wait to get there and play with her friends.  Thanks to the staff for creating a safe and fun environment for our dogs.

Amazing. Very friendly staff. Quick response to any queries. They even have a Webcam thru which u can watch your baby play. Our dog came home .. ate his food and off to sleep. It shows how much fun he had. Thank you everyone at petopia

Lots of space for my doggy to run around and play games and socialize. Staff are really committed to taking care of everyone's dog and create a positive experience. I found out about Petopia while fostering dogs through Speaking of Dogs and it is truly one of the best places.
Edited: An added feature is that they have dog grooming on-site by TinyTailz. Excellent grooming service

I’ve been taking my puppy Harley to Petopia for almost two months now I can’t say enough amazing things about this dog daycare!

From the moment we walked in, the staff greeted us with so much warmth and instantly showed they genuinely care about my puppy and have taken the time to get to know her personally. Its great, Harley comes home tired, content, and excited to go back every day.

If you’re looking for a place that feels like a second home for your dog, this is absolutely it. Highly recommend!

We love this place and so does our dog! It's been great helping our rescue socialize. The staff are so friendly, knowledgable, patient, and caring. The dogs spend most of their time outdoors playing, and they offer wonderful enrichment activities. Highly recommend.

My pup loves coming to Petopia! Staff are really nice and friendly, never had any issues with anything at all. I love how they provide webcams so I can see how my pup is doing throughout the day, and the enrichment activities are amazing.
Great place and prices are reasonable would definitely recommend. Staff are friendly and i like the fact their are cameras you can watch to see what your dog is doing
very easy to make bookings using a mobile app, friendly staff, my two dogs love this place
My dog loves it here! Service is great and you can tell the employees really care about the animals.

My pup started attending Petopia a few times a week in July and the experience has been fantastic from day one! The staff are all loving and supportive, giving dogs the space and attention they need. They do a great job of grouping dogs to play together, spend lots of time in the large yard with them, and come up with fun enrichment activities (like bobbing for apples!) to keep their minds engaged. We receive frequent report cards and pictures to keep us up to date on how our pup is doing. The report cards even include if the dogs napped, their behavior through the day, their favorite games, and which other dogs they played with the most that day. I intend to keep sending my pup and can’t recommend the place more!

Fantastic! Great price, they update you about your dog and I’m so pleased with how close they keep an eye on and get to know the dogs. Flagged a potential health issue for my girl as soon as they noticed it. The report cards are also very cute and helpful.

Vespers comes home happy and tired (obligatory post-Petopia sleep pic attached) but not manic like she did at other daycares. She’s been making friends and loooooves everyone who works there. It’s fantastic that they have cameras during play hours so I can check in on her and watch her zoom from pool to pool or run around with friends.

Thoroughly recommend if you want your dog to have a great time and be well cared for.

Our standard poodle stayed at Petopia for 5 weeks while we were on vacation. Throughout her entire stay, we always felt assured that she was being loved and well treated. In fact, she even seemed a little sad in the days that followed once we returned and brought her home. We would definitely recommend Petopia to anyone looking to board their dog and we would definitely use them again.

Absolutely love this daycare! Both of our dogs LOVE going to Petopia and we have all the trust and faith in the staff. They offer a daily report card, upload photos and genuinely love looking after our dogs and every other dog we see come and go. We have done kenneling and daycare and the pups can't wait to get back in the door for their next visit.

We were referred by a friend and fellow pet parent and it is one of the best choices we made, bringing our puppy Scout to Petopia. Tge staff are all super caring and love up on her and she doesnt even look back at us when we drop her off. She gets a chance to play with her friends, socialize with both staff and other dogs. Bringing her here has helped with some of the behaviors we were struggling with as new pet parents and the support and insight from staff when we have had questions has been invaluable. Thank you to Kendra, Logan, Paula Justin and Vanessa and all the staff at Petopia who take such amazing care of the dogs and truly seem to love what they do. You can check-in on your pup during the day and they have amazing enrichment activities that we always make sure Scout gets to enjoy. As a first time puppy parent
, having Petopia and their staff to care for her when we are at work makes us feel so great. I love the pictures, the report card and the easiness of getting her booked in. She loves it and never wants to leave, always going behind the front desk to say goodbye to whomever is there.

Petopia has become my family’s go-to place for boarding and doggie daycare for our 4-yr old fluffy family member and Samoyed, Sammy.  We are endlessly grateful for Pat and the incredible care her team provides for Sammy and all of his new furry friends, big and small.  The staff at Petopia go above and beyond to make sure Sammy feels loved, comfortable and engaged with plenty of social and play time - my family and I love checking in and watching Sammy during playtime using the web links provided… such a thoughtful touch!  Petopia has become a second home for our boy when we can’t take him with us, and we can’t imagine trusting anyone else.

Petopia truly feels like a second home for our dog, Hero. We’re so comforted knowing he gets supervised indoor and outdoor time every day, just like he would at home. His feeding schedule is followed precisely and kept on file for future visits, which gives us great peace of mind. The staff are always friendly and professional, and the owner, Pat, is absolutely amazing—she’s quick to respond to any questions or concerns. We’re so grateful to have found a place we trust completely!
Janette (pawrent)

My dog is a rescue and was scared of the world when I adopted him - visiting Petopia has been one of the key activities that have helped build his confidence, get comfortable with other dogs (he is now a social butterfly) and to trust people that aren't me. The staff is fantastic and really take the time to get to know each dog and their personalities. It's a great doggy daycare that I would strongly recommend to anyone.
Our dogs are older and had never experienced the doggy daycare environment before. However, after just five visits, they get very excited when it’s time to go again.  Thanks Petopia!

I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for someone who can helps you taking care of your dog. ❤️❤️❤️ Gigi and I were so happy and grateful for this wonderful place and also the prices are very reasonable too.

They take care of my dog with so much love and patience.

Our boy loves Petopia and he gets so excited every time we go that he cries and whines on route and practically drags us through the door!! He loves interacting with the staff and the other dogs & he always comes home happy and exhausted!

The staff are excellent at dealing with each dog’s needs and behaviours plus they are great at communicating information about his stay. They use technology to provide regular report cards and photos and they provide verbal feedback at pickup.

We recently boarded him while out of town and even though we missed him, it was comforting to know he was in good hands.

Thank you Petopia for taking care of our boy!!

Our puppy has loved going to petopia!  It's been so great for socialization.  I was worried about boarding her because she needs to sleep with someone but the cage free boarding has been great, and it's such a relief to know when we're away she'll be happy having slumber parties with all her friends
The thing that really sets Petopia apart is the staff. My dog is shy, fearful, and often clingy, but she just loves everyone here and doesn’t seem to want to come back home after being boarded.

Our dog Eddie LOVES Petopia! Whenever we tell him he's going to see his" friends" he gets so excited and starts jumping around in anticipation. All the staff are friendly and Pat, the owner, provides excellent customer service. Thank you to everyone at Petopia for taking care of our fur baby whenever we need a babysitter!

We feel very comfortable leaving Freddie at Petopia. The staff are all wonderful and welcome him by name when he arrives and he has made many doggie friends there.
There are a number of very positive aspects at Petopia;  The staff's professionalism, attentiveness, and genuine care for the dogs, video cameras so we can see how he’s doing, other dogs to socialize with , the large indoor and outdoor play areas, and smaller areas for feeding and naps. We found that Freddie has become more balanced, focused, and well-socialized after attending Petopia.  Our Freddie has a blast when he goes to Petopia!

We have been using Petopia for boarding our two dogs whenever we have vacation. Our neighbour recommended them to us. They are a large facility that really takes great care of our pups. It also helps for last minute bookings, because they can always accommodate.   The owner is extremely communicative and the rates are reasonable.  I especially like that we can book via their app.  So convenient!  I would not hesitate to recommend them.
My hound Espresso loves this daycare. There are many activities for the dogs and lots of good love and care from the staff

Petopia has been great for our puppy.  She attends daycare 2 days a week and loves it.  She cannot get in  the door quick enough.  They have helped her come out of her shyness. I would recommend Petopia for anyone looking for a doggy daycare.

I started bringing Mawlie about 2 months ago. She was only 3 and half months old and I was very nervous. The staff was very understanding and they assured me that I was not the first to feel this way and that my puppy would be safe and sound. I have brought her back every weekend since! She loves it there and is always super tired when she comes home, which is hard to do for a 5-month-old German Shepherd. I also love that they have links to cameras so you can check up on your puppy throughout the day. I would not bring my Mawlie or any other fur baby I might have in the future to any other doggy daycare!

Cathye
Our dogs love spending time at Petopia. We are always confident that they are well cared for.

Petopia has been a wonderful place for our dog. The staff is warm, professional, and clearly passionate about animals. The facility is clean, well-organized, and offers plenty of space and activities to keep dogs engaged and happy. Our pup always runs in excited and comes home tired and content. We’re really happy with the care our dog receives at Petopia and would definitely recommend it to other pet owners.

Petopia has been amazing for our big pup Bailey! She is so excited to get there and is welcomed by name every time. She has her friends and I love the report card we get on how she did that day and friends she made! It’s so good for socialization and exercise!! We have also brought our previous dog here over the years and will continue to go back!! Love it here!

My husband and I have nothing but the highest praise for Petopia. We have left our pup here many times, some short stays and some longer stays and he always comes home looking healthy and happy. They even take fabulous shots of him playing with his friends and the staff, plus the enrichment activities are so cute and fun for the pups and we always get to see footage of him on their instagram page :)

We know he gets a lot of fun and healthy play when he stays at Petopia. Having been a repeat customer we have gotten to know the staff a bit better now and we can see how much they are real animal lovers. We love knowing that he's in the hands and care of such attentive and compassionate staff. He gets spoiled with love at every visit.

We feel safe knowing that they ensure that each dog there is healthy and up to date with their necessary shots and medications.

They have been super accommodating for us when we had a medical emergency recently and we can't thank them enough!!! Thanks again, you guys are the best!!!

We can’t say enough good things about Petopia! Zaylee comes home completely played out—in the best way. She gets lots of time to play, run and socialize. Whether it’s daycare or an overnight stay, she always comes back happy, tired, and clearly well cared for. We know she’s having an amazing time every visit because she practically sprints through the door whenever we drop her off.

The team at Petopia is warm, reliable, and truly loves the dogs. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing Zaylee’s in such great hands!

I use their daycare service occasionally. I am glad I discovered this place after a daycare close to my home closed down. Petopia turned out to be an even better option with a great outdoor play area as well. I believe my dog is in good hands while there. I have a lot of respect for the staff taking care of so many dogs with different temperaments. It must be stressful at times.

Such a wonderful daycare! Our puppy was so timid at first but absolutely loves going to daycare now and comes home exhausted each night. We love the little touches of being able to see live streams throughout the day and receiving daily report cards to see how she’s doing and who her furry friends are. Great daycare with an awesome outdoor space - highly recommend!

My dog is best described as being very social with a lot of energy so nothing makes her happier than playing all day with other dogs.  For me, along with making my dog happy, cleanliness and safety are high priorities so Petopia is making us both very happy.  Thanks again to Pat and her staff.

We love Petopia! Our dog, Pancake, has been going since February and always comes home happy, well-loved and blissfully tired - the best combination. She literally pulls to get inside when we arrive, which says it all!

The staff are friendly, caring and clearly love what they do and the animals they care for. What really sets Petopia apart is how thoughtful they are in providing exciting and fun enrichment activities for pups that keep them engaged and thriving.

We know that Pancake is in the best hands, and we love seeing how much fun she has every time she visits Petopia. We can’t recommend it enough!

My dog pulls me into the daycare! He loves the staff and loves being a part of the Petopia family! The staff take great care of our pup. They are so friendly and knowledgeable. We never worry when he is there. He comes home exhausted from all the fun he had!

Petopia has been absolutely awesome. Whenever I leave my dog (toast) at their daycare I know he is in good hands and I can relax and be worry free. I also love that they have options to purchase food or anything urgent that we might forget on site. Love the staff and the services.

Petopia was recommended to me from a dog park friend. My bernedoodle, Pluto, is super energetic so I finding him the right daycare/boarding is very important to me. Petopia is the right fit for us. The staff is approachable and kind, and when my flight was canceled Petopia was very responsive and flexible. It really put me at ease knowing Pluto was well taken care of. Most importantly, Pluto is always so excited when we arrive.

My dog Willow absolutely loves going to daycare at Petopia! The staff are very attentive and always seem happy to see her — they of course know Willow by name. It’s such a relief knowing she’s in good hands, having the time of her life playing, socializing, and getting tons of love.

The facility is clean, well-organized, and super dog-friendly. I really appreciate the little updates and photos they send at the end of the day. They even have cameras so we can see Willow playing and having fun when there.

Petopia truly feels like a second home for her, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the care and attention she gets every day. Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for a trustworthy and loving daycare!
Dogs have a great time when they're there.  Love the report cards at the end of a stay. Definitely recommend it.

Petopia is a good place for the angels of 4 legs.
So ashamed of the people who writes bad reviews for something that the owner did.
Remember what every person does doesn’t reflect what their employees do.
The workers in Petopia are always trying to give the best experience to their loved pets.
Learn to have God in your hearts and stop judging others.

My pup has been attending Petopia since she was three months old and it’s seriously her favourite place to go! Every time without fail that I drop her off at daycare she is so eager to get inside she forgets to say goodbye to me! The staff know us both personally by name upon walking in (and I’ve seen them interact with other clients) nobody is treated like they’re replaceable. The staff are always so kind to my girl, my pup always runs to them jumping and kissing as she arrives and they equally give her the same energy back. I love that photos are uploaded from her adventures during her days - I always share them with my friends and family. We also get a good laugh from her report cards (ex. Enjoyed playing catch me if you can with staff) but jokes aside it’s very helpful to see her progress and who she spent her day with. I also really love that there are themed activities every month which make it exciting for both me and my pup to look forward to! I can’t recommend Petopia enough. PS thanks to Pat (owner) for always being so kind and helpful since the day I signed up.

I’ve taken my dog a number of times after a friend recommended them. She’s had overnights and daycare. Their prices are reasonable and my dog always comes back so tired and happy from all the playing. They also do fun activities throughout the month including optional enrichment you can opt into. The staff are friendly and it’s always fun to catch your dog in their social media.

Bo always loves spending time at Petopia. He has been to daycare and boarding and it's nice to know that he has a place where he feels safe and has lots of attention and playtime with his favorite dog friends. The team at Petopia has always been so patient and attentive with Bo. We would not go anywhere else.

Love Petopia! I trust them for taking care of Nugget. He was there for daycare and dog boarding post ACL surgery and the staff really took care of him!! He had a mix of time off and socialization depending on how the situation is. I really admire how much care they put into our furbabies!! Thank you so much!!

Rhubarb loves her days at Petopia <3 She is always excited to arrive and comes home tired! I've had a great experience with Petopia and am happy to have somewhere safe and fun for Rhubarb to go on my long work days.

Rocky is not a fan of leaving his home and is quite particular with people! With only a few visits, he seemed to have adjusted with no problems and found a few people to cling onto! I love the live cams too, so I can check up on him!
The staff at Petopia have always made sure to take care of Tripper! We love the outdoor play area and the flexibility of the payment plans

Petopia is ‘home away from home’ for my mini chocolate brown cockapoo, Jade. She’s at the tail end of ‘puppyhood’ with lots of energy and she gets activity, exercise, and cuddles from all staff. Jade is a social girl but can be a bit anxious (maybe a titch persnickety at times:)), and her needs are always met with a positive approach. When Jade started daycare she was cautious, and within a couple weeks she was eager to go, thanks to everyone, the programming, and communication. Getting weekly report cards and pictures was a very nice personal touch! Jade’s a pleaser and in return requires human attention as much as puppy play, which she gets lots of both. There is plenty of space and room for dogs of all sizes to make furry friends. Recently Jade had her first boarding experience for a few nights. I got updates and pictures and felt comfortable knowing she was being well taken care of. Now I can start to plan longer trips with the reassurance she has a ‘home away from home’!
Thank you Pat and all ‘Petopians’ for helping Jade be her best self and grow with confidence. Jade and her paw-parents appreciate all that you do!

My Cooper squeals with delight when we arrive in the parking lot - he can't wait to get inside to play with his friends ....
That being said - I feel very comfortable leaving him in their care. They go above and beyond.

Enclosing my boys Halloween photo shoot.  I was super surprised by the beautiful gift they sent home with him today for Christmas 🎄.

They have webcams as well so you can watch the day to day activities - and a scheduled time out for the dogs to rest.

Highly, highly recommend this location for their doggie daycare.

Thanks for everything that you do!!

I love bringing my dog Espresso here!
When we were looking for a daycare to bring Espresso to, one thing that stood out to me was that I was able to get a tour of the facility, after visiting and inquiring about daycare (no appointment needed). Since then, Espresso has been many times and even boarded for a week. Espresso is a redbone coonhound and his breed gets attached to their owners - Petopia took that into consideration and they really met his needs while he was boarding.
Another great thing is that after each daycare visit and boarding stay, we get feedback on Espresso’s time.
Lastly - the cherry on top of this daycare facility is the big backyard.

They always go above and beyond for my dog, Roy, from providing a coat when I forgot to bringing peace of mind with their live cams. The staff is so caring and professional. I highly recommend Petopia.

My dog Lily loves Petopia and also goes to the groomer Stephanie at Tiny Tailz as well. We love that Lily gets to spend time outside and the facility is amazing and clean. Lily loves the special programs and photo days that they have. The staff and Pat are amazing and always follows up with Report Cards so we know how Lily's day went. Keep up the good work Pat and Team.
I would recommend Petopia, my dog loves going. The staff are really nice and they take good care of him.

I couldn’t be more grateful that I found Petopia for my puppy. He’s full of energy, but also very attached to me. He was nervous on his first day at Petopia, but on the second day and every day after, he doesn’t he look back at me. I watched the cameras more than I should, and my puppy is always so active and happy. So grateful for this place.
My dog really love this place. Convenient working hours (lots of time they accepted my dog before 6:30am (opening hours) and seems like people there love what they are doing

Petopia is amazing!  The staff is great, friendly and wonderful with my dog.  But most importantly my dog loves it.  We will be leaving our dog at Petopia for a month and I feel confident and secure knowing he'll be in a great hands.
Snoopy loves his time at Petopia. He has made lots of friends, both 2 and 4 legged.  Lots of play and lots of ❤️.
My dog Neo loves it there.  The staff is great and super attentive!

We have been going to Petopia since September and my pup absolutely loves it. The staff have been absolutely wonderful and genuinely seem to love spending time with the little guy. He bounces off the walls each week when it’s time for daycare. The outdoor space is a huge perk and really helps with his high energy since he loves the run! Huge fan of the report cards and the pictures available through the app at the end of each visit. We have boarded once and it’s a great comfort to know there is a safe outlet for care along with fun whenever I am away. The large facility along with the flexibility is a great fit for our needs and we could not be happier with their services.

Best decision I made was to sign Luna up for daycare/boarding with Petopia. Luna is thriving because of the care and love she gets with everyone at petopia. Luna is a sensitive, shy girl and it has been amazing to see that within 2 weeks of being at petopia how excited she gets when she realizes where she is going. Everyone is so nice and welcoming. Thank you Petopia!!
